description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing synchronization state data in a Room database, including methods to retrieve the last sync time and to upsert sync state entities.

classes.name: SyncStateDao
classes.description: DAO interface for managing sync state in local database storage.

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the last synchronization timestamp for a given key from the database.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts or updates a SyncStateEntity in the database, replacing existing records on conflict.

calls: Query("SELECT lastSyncAt FROM sync_state WHERE key = :key LIMIT 1")
